subject: RM_Pillowmoss
departures: a fat, swollen, domed cushion with real height and bulk, not a thin flat carpet of moss
low and squat, hugging the ground as a single rounded mound, with no stems, fronds or upright sprigs
surface covered in beads of fog water, droplets clearly visible all over the cushion
a ring of dark, visibly wet ground right around its base that stands out against the dry plain
